programme.title: Andromeda: Den spedalskes kys
programme.desc: En lejemorder ved navn Leper er ude efter lederne af det nye Commonwealth.

programme.title: Andromeda: For Whom the Bell Tolls
programme.desc: Andromeda bliver hjemsøgt af et mystisk væsen, der kommer om bord under en solstorm.

programme.title: Andromeda: And Your Heart Will Fly Away
programme.desc: Da en længe savnet kærlighed vender tilbage, forsvinder Tyr fra skibet for at beskytte hende mod en lejemorder.
programme.sub-title: And Your Heart Will Fly Away

programme.title: Andromeda: Den uovervindelige mand
programme.desc: Spiller i et alternativt univers, hvor Dylan er død, og Gaheris Rhade forsøger at reformere Commonwealth.

programme.title: Andromeda: Delenda Est
programme.desc: Den gruppe, der angreb Andromeda under den første underskrivelse af Commonwealth-charter, vender tilbage for at skabe mere ravage.

programme.title: Andromeda: Det mørke bagud
programme.desc: Trance gennemgår nogle forskellige scenarier og forsøger at finde et, hvor hendes besætningsmedlemmer ikke dør.

programme.title: Andromeda: Risiko-alt-punktet
programme.desc: Et kraftigere Andromeda skib eksploderer sandsynligvis på grund af sabotage, hvilket tvinger Dylans besætning til at redde dem.

programme.title: Andromeda: Den rigtige hest
programme.desc: Beka bringer både sin besætning og en hel planet i fare, da en tidligere kærlighed dukker op.

programme.title: Andromeda: Hvad sker der med en udskudt rev?
programme.desc: Andromeda modtager et råb om hjælp fra Rev Bam.
programme.sub-title: Hvad sker der med en udskudt rev?

programme.title: Andromeda: Spidsen af spyddet
programme.desc: Efter at en planet i Commonwealth bliver angrebet af pyroformere fra Pyrian, er Dylan tvunget til at kæmpe for at beskytte den nye planet.

programme.title: Andromeda: Himlens hvælving
programme.desc: Dylan hører stemmer, der lokker ham til en planet med "ild og is".

programme.title: Andromeda: Deep Midnight's Voice
programme.desc: Mens besætningen er fanget i en kamp mellem to nietzscheanske stolthedspunkter, fanger besætningen en fjendtlig person, der hævder, at hans stolthed har et kort over slipstrømmen

programme.title: Andromeda: Illusionen om majestæt
programme.desc: Et forkert sving efter at have forladt en slipstream sender Andromeda ind i Prolon-systemet. De redder en flugtkapsel fra en sikker katastrofe, men stoltheden vil have den tilbage.

programme.title: Andromeda: Idolernes tusmørke
programme.desc: Besætningen søger efter en forsvundet koloni af nietzscheanere og opdager en anden besætning, der i hemmelighed har hjulpet dem

programme.title: Andromeda: Dommens dag, vredens dag
programme.desc: Besætningen installerer en ny AI i et nyt slagskib fra Commonwealth, og naturligvis går tingene ikke som de skal.

programme.title: Andromeda: Skygger kastet af en sidste hilsen
programme.desc: Tyr overbeviser nietzscheanerne om, at han er en reinkarnation af Drago Museveni
programme.sub-title: Skygger kastet af en sidste hilsen

programme.title: Andromeda: Svar på spørgsmål, der aldrig er blevet stillet
programme.desc: En besked fra en samler sender Dylan ud på en mission for at redde et gidsel og finde resterne af Commonwealth-flåden.
programme.sub-title: Svar på spørgsmål, der aldrig er blevet stillet

programme.title: Andromeda: Pieces of Eight
programme.desc: Citizen Eight forsøger at fjerne Dylan fra kommandoen over Andromeda.

programme.title: Andromeda
programme.desc: Besætningen skal stoppe en verdens skibsbygger, før han starter en ny invasion

programme.title: Andromeda
programme.desc: Dylan bliver kidnappet af nietzscheanere og tvunget til at spille tankespil til sin fangevogteres fornøjelse.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Hell's Kitchen
programme.desc: When Kristine Fitzhugh failed to show up for her music class, her husband found her dead at the bottom of the stairs of their Palo Alto home. Further investigation reveals evidence of murder in the kitchen.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Three's a Crowd
programme.desc: In 1999, Susan Fassett was gunned down as she left her church choir practice in Poughkeepsie, NY. After clearing her husband, police turned their attention to Fred Andros, with whom Susan had an affair.

programme.title: Forensic Files: A Squire's Riches
programme.desc: Responding to a 2008 garage fire, Illinois emergency response discovered a man crushed beneath a truck.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Home of the Brave
programme.desc: In 2007, the Florida mobile home of Effie and Michael Ratley catches fire. Michael heroically rescues his wife and infant son. A month later, his wife is found beaten to death in a bedroom of his parents' home.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Freeze Framed
programme.desc: In 2005, David Castor suffered a slow, agonizing death over a period of days. His wife maintained it was suicide, even though it was done with antifreeze.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Touch of Evil
programme.desc: In the 1990s, the media dubbed Richard Rogers the "Last Call Killer" because he targeted men in gay bars who were obviously intoxicated.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Textbook Murder
programme.desc: Avis Banks and her unborn child were brutally murdered. The body was discovered by her fiancé, Keyon Pittman. When police learned that Pittman was having affairs with other women, he became the prime suspect.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Filtered Out
programme.desc: In 2000, teenager Tara Munsey went missing after a work shift at a Virginia restaurant. Did she run away, or was she the victim of foul play?

programme.title: Forensic Files: Water Logged
programme.desc: In 1989, the dead bodies of Joan Rogers and her two teenage daughters were found floating in Tampa Bay.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Social Circle
programme.desc: In 2003, Tiffany Rowell and three of her friends were brutally murdered in affluent Clear Lake, Texas.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Low Maintenance
programme.desc: In 2008, college co-ed Jenna Verhaalen was found dead in her Bryan, Texas apartment. Petechial hemorrhages in her eyes indicated that she was strangled.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Fate Date
programme.desc: In 2004, Rebecca Barney and her soon-to-be ex-husband Fred were found shot to death in their Tulsa, Oklahoma, home, which had been set on fire.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Trail of a Killer
programme.desc: In 2003, Kathy Lorick was murdered on a Concord, California jogging trail while talking to her husband on her mobile phone.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Gone Ballistic
programme.desc: In 2008, the body of Colorado real estate developer Alan Helmick was found by his wife, Miriam, who then became the prime suspect.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Seeing Red
programme.desc: In 2005, the body of young mother Summer Baldwin was found in a suitcase in a Texas landfill.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Skeleton Key
programme.desc: In 2004, nursing student Tamika Huston went missing from her Spartanburg, South Carolina home. A tip led detectives to her car, where they found an unknown house key that could help solve the case.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Funeral Services
programme.desc: In 2002, funeral director Lonnie Turner, Sr. was found shot to death. His son Lonnie Jr. became the prime suspect, particularly after it was discovered that the murder was committed with his gun. However, he had an alibi for the time of the murder.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Expert Witness
programme.desc: In 1993, young mother Tammy Tatum was sexually assaulted and murdered in her Longmont, Colorado apartment. Police initially suspected her estranged husband, but did not have enough evidence to charge him and the case went cold.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Marked for Life
programme.desc: It would take 46 years, handwriting analysis and new fingerprint technology to solve the 1957 murders of two California police officers.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Plastic Puzzle
programme.desc: A man riding a bicycle was fatally injured in what police believed to be a hit-and-run accident. Tiny clues found at the scene created a picture of the vehicle which struck him and led police to its driver.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Up in Smoke
programme.desc: When an elderly couple died in a suspicious house fire, their son became the prime suspect. Investigators turned to forensic science to determine if the fire had been set deliberately, or if it was an unfortunate accident.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Soiled Plan
programme.desc: Police instituted an intense search when the mother of two young children went missing. Twenty years after her body was found, new technology recontextualized old evidence and pointed directly to the killer.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Headquarters
programme.desc: When hunters reported finding a skull in a Texas canyon, police immediately began an investigation. With a forensic artist's reconstruction, police eventually learned the victim's identity. Now all they had to do was find her killer.

programme.title: Forensic Files: One for the Road
programme.desc: A married couple decided to escape the cold of winter with a mini-vacation in Key West. The wife went missing and police searched every square inch of the island; they found nothing but a pair of sandals which might have belonged to her.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Army of Evidence
programme.desc: A mother of two young children was found dead in her bedroom. Her death was ruled a suicide — but when investigators learned she had almost died in a house fire three years earlier, they decided to take another look at the evidence.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Shear Luck
programme.desc: In 1991, when the wife of a serviceman was brutally murdered in the Philippines, investigators had to reassemble a tiny computer disk that had been cut to pieces in order to find the killer.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Tagging a Suspect
programme.desc: Bombings are difficult to solve because the perpetrator isn't usually at the scene and the evidence goes up in smoke. In this case, pieces of plastic the size of grains of sand hold the key to finding a murderer.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Strong Impressions
programme.desc: The wife of an Air Force officer was found dead in her bed with a plastic laundry bag near her face. Further investigation proved that the scene had been staged. Her death wasn't an accident — it was cold-blooded murder.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Cereal Killer
programme.desc: When a fire destroyed most of a home and a young boy went missing, police organized the largest search in the history of their small town. First the boy's backpack was discovered five miles from home, then his body was found 50 miles away.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Crash Course
programme.desc: A highway patrolman was dispatched to what he thought would be a routine traffic accident — until he looked in the car. He had seen hundreds of accidents, but none with as much blood as this.

programme.title: Forensic Files: A Leg Up On Crime
programme.desc: The decomposed body of a young woman was discovered in a Bakersfield irrigation canal. If there was trace evidence, it had been washed away.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Tight-Fitting Genes
programme.desc: A behavioral profile caused the Baton Rouge Police Department to search for the wrong man. The real perpetrator may have eluded arrest, had it not been for a molecular biologist who painted DNA picture of the suspect.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Deadly Valentine
programme.desc: An obstetrician returned home from the hospital and found his wife on the bathroom floor. She was covered with blood and not breathing. He tried unsuccessfully to revive her, staining his clothes with her blood in the process.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Picture This
programme.desc: A Modesto, California teenager goes missing. With no signs of struggle in her home, police suspect she has simply run away — until her naked, bruised body is discovered in a ditch 20 miles away.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Oily in the Morning
programme.desc: When police recovered the submerged car of a missing man, they expected to find his body — but it wasn't there. The investigation that followed would uncover an obsession turned deadly.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Gold Rush
programme.desc: Emergency dispatch received a call from a man who said his girlfriend shot and killed herself. The autopsy revealed that the gunshot wound was not self-inflicted, and the evidence on her body would give police a golden opportunity to catch her killer.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Four on the Floor
programme.desc: When a Native American woman is brutally killed in the desert of New Mexico, her killers leave a crime scene rich in forensic evidence: tire tracks, shoe impressions and even the murder weapons.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The True Story of Mississippi Burning
programme.desc: Philadelphia, Mississippi, 1964. A sleepy southern town steeped in tradition finds itself targeted for invasion.
programme.sub-title: The True Story of Mississippi Burning

programme.title: The FBI Files: A Model Killer
programme.desc: It's a model's job to rivet the public's attention. But in 1984, some aspiring models began attracting publicity in a terrible new way.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Hired Gun
programme.desc: When three people were found murdered in their home, it appeared like a burglary gone awry. But a crime this horrific deserved a closer look.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Cat and Mouse
programme.desc: He was a predator, abducting girls and young women from their own front yards in broad daylight. He was a sadist: phoning one victim's family, taunting them, boosting then dashing their hope, and he wouldn't stop until we stopped him.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Cracking The Cartel
programme.desc: A mother and child are kidnapped a bystander is murdered. Violence such as this shattered a quiet Texas neighborhood and exposed a drug cartel that flourished where it was least expected.

programme.title: The FBI Files: A Stranger in Town
programme.desc: She appeared on the highway in the spring, a young woman, her life cut short, her past and her identity a mystery. Only by finding out who she was could we ever hope to find her killer.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Hunter's Game
programme.desc: In the 1970s and 80s, people went to Alaska looking for a fresh start, to reinvent themselves, or to disappear for a while. Some of those disappearances weren't by choice.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Dixie Mafia
programme.desc: On Mississippi's Gulf Coast, a Judge and his politician wife are murdered in their home. The killer left few clues. It looked like a professional hit, and the investigation led nowhere. But the FBI refused to give up.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Shattered Shield
programme.desc: In a city awash in narcotics the drug lords have all the power even over the police. Corruption in New Orleans grew like cancer, eating away at public safety and threatening to destroy the city. Crooked cops break the laws they were sworn to uphold.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Blood Brothers
programme.desc: When the small community of Noel, Missouri discovered their bank was robbed, they're shocked. When the bank president turned up missing, they're outraged. And when clues began to surface the facts were more terrible than anyone could have guessed.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Crime Spree
programme.desc: They swept through six states like a plague, thrill killers acting without rhyme or reason. They targeted adults and young girls, kidnapping, and murdering. And in their rampage, they left plenty of clues, but moving targets are the hardest to hit.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Family Secrets
programme.desc: A woman and her infant son vanish. The husband is frantic. The clues are scarce, but hopes linger, even as the hours and days tick by without a word. Was she on the run, or the victim of foul play?

programme.title: The FBI Files: Master Plan
programme.desc: Willow Springs, Illinois, seemed like any other quiet Midwestern community. But it was really one of the most corrupt places in the nation. This tiny village, nestled just outside of Chicago, was in the hip pocket of organized crime.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Firefight
programme.desc: In Miami, a gang of robbers targeted banks and armored cars. They carried assault weapons and weren't afraid to use them. They struck during the day, and sometimes twice a day. For awhile, they seemed unstoppable.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Killer Abroad
programme.desc: Beginning in 1990, Europe found itself in the clutches of a serial killer. He became an international outlaw, hopping from country to country to evade capture and to kill again.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Moving Target
programme.desc: When a sniper in Utah started targeting African-American men for death, authorities launched a massive investigation. With scant clues and no witnesses they found the odds stacked against them, and they had no idea where the killer would strike next.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Deadly Mission
programme.desc: When a family was murdered in Arkansas, it seemed like an isolated event. But soon the crime was revealed to be part of an ever-widening circle of violence that defined a new age of domestic terrorism.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Cop Killer
programme.desc: In 1995, our nation's capital was also our nation's murder capital. Even the police weren't safe. While Washington, DC, law enforcement targeted criminals, the criminals targeted law enforcement, even gunning down officers on patrol.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Silent Killers
programme.desc: Weeks pass as forensic investigators search for even the smallest clues, only to find what they feared in their own backyard. In Canada, two people die suddenly of unknown causes, and their deaths may not be as coincidental as they first appear.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Out To Kill
programme.desc: An abandoned car outside Philadelphia brings heartbreak to a family and terror to a community. A young woman is dead, the killer gone. But the marks of his passage remain.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Raw Greed
programme.desc: A friendly Midwest lodge becomes the scene of a gruesome double murder. Two men are dead and a safe filled with cash is missing.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Murderous Attraction
programme.desc: In Columbus, Ohio, a woman is found shot in the head. The death is ruled a suicide, but something is not right and detectives refuse to let the matter rest.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Broken Trust
programme.desc: A New York homebuyer gets more than he bargained for when a house inspection turns up a mummified corpse. For decades, the crime had gone undiscovered. The victim unmissed, and the killer unpunished.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Price of Murder
programme.desc: Using science as their most powerful weapon, investigators must find these hired killers and make them pay the true price of murder.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Stolen Youths
programme.desc: A young girl playing in her yard in Spokane, Washington suddenly vanishes. In St. Louis, another girl leaves to visit a friend. She never arrived.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Loved To Death
programme.desc: A victim usually never foresees danger when the perpetrator turns out to be a friend or a lover. Science and microscopic evidence can unmask these killers and find justice for those who are Loved To Death.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Written in Blood
programme.desc: In North Carolina, the home of a prominent couple becomes an unlikely scene of terrible bloodshed. Across the country, a California woman vanishes, worrying her family and the investigators trying to find her.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Critical Evidence
programme.desc: To the astute detective and forensic specialist, the biggest clues often hide in plain sight, and what seems trivial to some is in reality Critical Evidence.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Fateful Twist
programme.desc: A southeastern Virginia community is stunned by a crime no one can believe. A pregnant woman murdered, her baby lost. Across the state, another town feels a similar shock, a brutal, random slaying in a most unexpected setting.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Vanished
programme.desc: In New York, an ambitious college student has her whole life ahead of her, until she crosses the path of a killer. It's a random murder, the hardest kind to solve.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Lethal Obsessions
programme.desc: Some people will let nothing stand between them and their goals. In their tortured minds, raw desire replaces all reason, and homicide becomes a convenient means to an end.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Traces Of Guilt
programme.desc: Sometimes the scales of justice are balanced by just a few milligrams of evidence: a couple of fibers, a tooth filling, or a smudge on a piece of tape. The biggest cases are often solved by the smallest clues.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Electronic Witness
programme.desc: George Orwell's concept of Big Brother remains in the realm of fiction. But as technology becomes more a part of our lives, it's becoming increasingly more difficult to make a move without leaving behind an electronic trace.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Dead Wrong
programme.desc: Hiding a body can be difficult; it's sometimes easier to obscure or disguise the circumstances of the death, turning murder into suicide, or pinning the blame on someone else. The truth is told through subtle clues taken from the crime scene.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Lasting Impressions
programme.desc: No matter how chaotic or how clean a crime scene appears to be, the culprit is bound to leave something telling behind. Occasionally, it's nothing more than a fingerprint or shoe tread. Sometimes that's all that's needed.

programme.title: Pure Fly NZ: Opening Weekend
programme.desc: Two words more magical to the ears of a fly fisher than 'Opening Weekend'? In New Zealand's South Island, the red letter day is the last day in September.

programme.title: Pure Fly NZ: West Coast Explorer
programme.desc: Good mates Ronan Creane and Jeff Forsee head off on a mission to explore the myriad of trout fishing options available on the beautiful West Coast of NZ's South Island.

programme.title: Pure Fly NZ: East Cape Raft Mission
programme.desc: NZ fly fishing champion Cory Scott and his good mate Chris Sharland venture deep into the East Cape for a challenging but ultimately rewarding multi-day rafting trip.

programme.title: Pure Fly NZ: Southland Willow Grubbers
programme.desc: Rene Vaz and Mike Wilkinson head into the deep south during the peak of summer in the hope that the famously large brown trout of the region will have begun feeding heavily on willow grubs.

programme.title: Robson's Extreme Fishing Challenge: Episode 5
programme.desc: Robson Green travels the World challenging the best fisherman to catch the biggest, best fish across the planet.

programme.title: Robson's Extreme Fishing Challenge: Episode 6
programme.desc: Robson Green travels the World challenging the best fisherman to catch the biggest, best fish across the planet.

programme.title: Robson's Extreme Fishing Challenge: Episode 7
programme.desc: Robson Green travels the World challenging the best fisherman to catch the biggest, best fish across the planet.

programme.title: Robson's Extreme Fishing Challenge: Episode 8
programme.desc: Robson Green travels the World challenging the best fisherman to catch the biggest, best fish across the planet.

programme.title: IFISH: Wyangala Dam, New South Wales
programme.desc: Whether you want to troll lures for cod, collect your own live bait and target yellas, or battle huge mud marlin on small soft plastics - Wyangala Dam is the place to be.

programme.title: IFISH: Daly River, Northern Territory
programme.desc: When I asked Shane Compain to pick the best day of the year for myself and the IFISH Team to come smack some serious barramundi - he did not disappoint!

programme.title: IFISH: Hinchinbrook Region, Queensland
programme.desc: It's not often that you go fishing somewhere so picturesque, so pristine and so untouched that you seriously think to yourself "I wouldn't even care if I didn't get a bite"... but then you absolutely SMACK IT TOO!

programme.title: IFISH: ATA Lodge, Alagnak River, Alaska - Part 2
programme.desc: When Paul says he guarantee's you won't be disappointed, he ain't lying! Landing monster mutilated hook-jaw zombie chum salmon on fly, while bears patrol the banks, fishing around you. It's gotta be seen to be believed!
programme.sub-title: ATA Lodge, Alagnak River, Alaska - Part 2

programme.title: IFISH: Alexandra, Victoria
programme.desc: Victoria has long been known for its capital city Melbourne, over the top hipsters and its AFL football religion. But 12 pound rainbow trout one after the other? Ahhh...WHAT!

programme.title: IFISH: Cullen Bay, Northern Territory
programme.desc: When life gives you lemons - make lemonade. When life gets you down - get back up. When life gives you dead flat seas, 40 degree heat, a sounder lit up like a Christmas tree and 1 hour left of fishing - make great TV!

programme.title: IFISH: Mornington, Victoria
programme.desc: There's nothing quite like getting back to basics and garfish off the local pier - that's what I love! Learn all the tricks, to ensure you too can grab a feed down your local and even cook them up like a Master Chef!

programme.title: Pure Fly NZ: Mackenzie Country Canal Trout - Part 1
programme.desc: Angler Anto Hall teams up with Charles Smith for a mission into the Mackenzie Country in search of a canal monster. The team soon learn that fly fishing for these giant fish can be pretty darn tricky!

programme.title: Pure Fly NZ: Mackenzie Country Canal Trout - Part 2
programme.desc: The team fish into the darkness and battle plummeting temperatures as they chase an an elusive 30lb+ monster in the Mackenzie Country canals.

programme.title: Pure Fly NZ: North Island Tiki Tour
programme.desc: Andrew Harding and Matt Hince go on a campervan tour of some of the North Island's best back country trout fishing. There's action aplenty, and as usual with these two characters, a lot of laughs!

programme.title: Pure Fly NZ: Fiordland Mouse Trout
programme.desc: We join Anto Hall and Nick Geddes as they search the remote lakes of Fiordland for the mysterious 'mouse feeding trout' and Anto manages to catch the largest brown trout of his life!

programme.title: Pure Fly NZ: The Mighty Tongariro

programme.title: The Hills: New Year, New Friends
programme.desc: Laurens 21. Fødselsdag er fuld af overraskelser, da Heidi og Audrina holder en fest for hende. Jen prøver at slutte fred med Lauren.

programme.title: The Hills: Apology Not Accepted
programme.desc: Lauren fylder 21 og Heidi har store planer for fødselsdagsfesten. Men inden festen beslutter Heidi, det er tid til at fortælle Lauren om Spencers idé om at flytte sammen.

programme.title: The Hills: Everyone Falls
programme.desc: Med udsigt til et nyt job, falder Whitney over sin største mulighed med Teen Vogue. Spencer går for vidt, da han presser Heidi til at forlade Lauren og flytte ind med ham.

programme.title: The Hills: Goodbye for Now
programme.desc: I sæsonfinalen tilspidses tingene, da Heidi beslutter at flytte ind med Spencer. Lauren vil have Audrina til at fylde tomrummet efter hendes bedste veninde, og Whitney flyver til New York til et interview.

programme.title: The Hills: You Know What You Did
programme.desc: Lauren går ikke til Heidi and Spencers housewarming fordi Heidi har spredt rygter om hende. Så da Lauren løber ind i Heidi har de et kæmpe skænderi.

programme.title: The Hills: Big Girls Don't Cry
programme.desc: Lauren og Heidi bliver endnu mere uvenner da Spencer frier til Heidi. Audrina finder sammen med en ekskæreste og Lauren vender hjem til Laguna Beach for at få et godt råd.

programme.title: The Hills: Truth And Time Tells All
programme.desc: Lauren prøver at hjælpe Audrina med at beslutte om Justin har kærestekvalitet, men Audrina har allerede truffet sin beslutning. Heidi finder ud af, at det ikke er lutter lagkage at være forlovet.

programme.title: The Hills: Meet The Parents
programme.desc: Ifølge mig: et komisk twist på din yndlings reality-serie. Fra Lauren til Spencer og alle de andre, intet bitchy look eller bromance udelades af skuespilleren, der spilleralle de medvirkende.

programme.title: The Hills: Rolling With The Enemy
programme.desc: Heidis sociale omgangskreds krymper da Spencer 'slår op' med Brody fordi han har hængt ud med Lauren. Audrina vil være fast kæreste med Justin, men det nægter han at gå med til.

programme.title: The Hills: Second Chances
programme.desc: Lauren bliver ringet op af en ekskæreste. Heidi konkurrerer med sin kollega Elodie om at blive forfremmet på arbejdet.

programme.title: The Hills: They Meet Again
programme.desc: Laurens følelser for Jason blusser op, men da de løber ind i Heidi og Spencer på en restaurant går bølgerne højt. Heidis forfremmelse hos Bolthouse koster hendes venskab med Elodie.

programme.title: The Hills: For Better Or Worse
programme.desc: Lauren bliver chokeret da hun hører, at Jason har en kæreste, men Jason har en endnu større overraskelse oppe i ærmet. Heidi finder ud af at Spencer ikke har fortalt sine forældre om deres bryllupsplaner.

programme.title: The Hills: What Happens In Vegas...
programme.desc: Hele slænget fejrer Brodys fødselsdag i Vegas. Audrinas kæreste Justin skaber splid i venskabet med Lauren. Lauren og Brodys tiltrækkes mere og mere af hinanden.

programme.title: Celebrity Ex on the Beach: Aftenstranden
programme.desc: Kan Lockie og Yaz finde ud af at bo sammen? Chloe lægger alle sine æg i en kurv og en djævelsk flot kendis ryster villaen, men hvem ryger hjem nu?

programme.title: Celebrity Ex on the Beach: Den eneste vej er eks
programme.desc: To ekser bliver elimineret, og James bliver knust. Yaz og Lockie prøver en sidste gang at slutte fred. En kendiseks laver ravage og villaen siger farvel til en OG.

programme.title: Celebrity Ex on the Beach: Historien gentager sig
programme.desc: Jarred er frustreret og oprørt, Tamara føler, at historien kan gentage sig og Callum slår til.

programme.title: Celebrity Ex on the Beach: Hænger i en tynd tråd
programme.desc: En ny kendis truer med at spolere et allerede skrøbeligt parforhold. Tamara kommer videre fra Joe og Paige er i et trekantsdrame mellem gammel og ny.

programme.title: Celebrity Ex on the Beach: Flamme-ceremoni
programme.desc: Der er en chokeliminering, som ryster villaen. Paige må tage en kæmpestor beslutning, og den sidste aften bliver en tåreperser for kendisserne i en flammende ceremoni.

programme.title: Ex On The Beach: Kayleigh's Crisis
programme.desc: 'Ex on the Beach' er tilbage! Otte hotte singler får snart ødelagt alle tiders ferie, da en af deres ekser ankommer og ødelægger festen! Had, skænderier, tårer, drama, følelser og endnu flere ekser!

programme.title: Ex On The Beach: Love Triangles and Squares
programme.desc: Ankomsten af to ekser skaber kaos i villaen for alle, og det bliver kun værre. Rogans forhold til Anita går i stykker, når hans eks Jess ankommer på Dommedagsstranden. Mere kærlighed, mere had og vigtigst af alt flere ekser.

programme.title: Ex On The Beach: Secrets and Betrayals
programme.desc: Tre ekser i villaen betyder, at bølgerne går højt. Kayleigh bliver forrådt af sin ven Loren, der har kysset hendes eks Adam, og ankomsten af to ekser inkluderer et berømt ansigt, der dukker op af havet.

programme.title: Ex On The Beach: I'm Sorry, I'm a Prick
programme.desc: Fem ekser er i villaen og alle er anspændte efter ankomsten af Gaz fra Geordie Shore. Gary bager på Anita og de falder for hinanden. Men hendes eks dukker op af havet, og han knuste hendes hjerte. Imens har Adam en forfærdelig tid.

programme.title: Ex On The Beach: Star Gazing
programme.desc: Joes ankomst chokerer alle og Anita bliver helt ødelagt. Kayleigh skaber sig og fortæller Joe, at Anita har fjollet rundt med to af fyrene. Den næste eks er et velkendt ansigt som kan ødelægge det for Gaz og Anita. Velkommen Charlotte!

programme.title: Ex On The Beach: The Gloves Are Off
programme.desc: Jess hører, at Rogan har kysset Megan og hævner sig ved at kysse hans bedste ven, Morgan. Bromancen ligger på is og villaen er nået smeltepunktet. Imens er Adam gået til Charlotte, og hun og Kayleigh skændes vildt.

programme.title: Ex On The Beach: Girl Code
programme.desc: Op af havet kommer et kendt ansigt - Ash fra den første sæson af Ex on the Beach - og han vil skabe KAOS. Alle pigerne er vilde med ham, fyrene frygter op og når Ash henter Anita til en privat fest, bryder helvede løs og Gary går amok!

programme.title: Ex On The Beach: Anita's Almighty Meltdown
programme.desc: Det er næsten forbi, og nogle af ekserne slutter fred, men andre vil aldrig blive enige. Gruppen holder festmiddag og Anita får et sammenbrud, der overgår alle andre. Men hvem får et chok under den sidste tur til stranden?

programme.title: Ex On The Beach US
programme.desc: 10 stjerner fra reality-tv og sociale medier tror, at de er på en sexet tropeferie, men paradiset forvandles til et mareridt, når deres ekser dukker op på stranden. Vil det tænde gamle flammer eller åbne gamle sår?

programme.title: Ex On The Beach US: Being Shady 101
programme.desc: Den 10. single ankommer til villaen og lander midt i en kærlighedstrekant. Farrah provokerer sine bofæller. En eks spreder et ondt rygte, når sårede følelser giver sig udtryk i hævn.

programme.title: Ex On The Beach US: Simon Says
programme.desc: Farrah får en stor overraskelse i Hemmelighedshulen. En eks af en eks dukker op og laver ravage i et spirende forhold og afslører nogle løgne. Den første eks bliver sendt hjem.

programme.title: Ex On The Beach US: Worst Date Ever
programme.desc: To ekser går ssammen for at vælte Maya og hendes slæng. En uventet overraskelse bringer et af husets stærkeste par i fare.

programme.title: Ex On The Beach US: Jay Is For Jealous
programme.desc: Huset fejrer Farrahs tilbagevenden. Jalousi starter en fysisk konfrontation, da en intim sandhed bliver afsløret. Noget uventet sker ved eliminering.

programme.title: Ex On The Beach US: Low Blows
programme.desc: En forventet eks-ankomst starter et ordentligt skænderi, da ulmende spændinger omsider eksploderer. Farrah blander sig i andres sager og gør huset mere kaotisk.

programme.title: Ex On The Beach US: Revenge is Sweet
programme.desc: Handlinger har konsekvenser, da ekserne hører om de slemme ting, som singlerne har sagt om dem. Jays usikkerhed om Morgans ekser når kogepunktet.

programme.title: Ex On The Beach US: Here Comes Trouble
programme.desc: Et ustabilt forhold bliver turbulent da Angela vender tilbage til stranden for at lave ravage og stjæle nogle mænd. Huset flipper ud, da en fest kører af sporet.

programme.title: Ex On The Beach US: Un-Bear-Able
programme.desc: Sandheden om Murrays skumle fortid bliver blotlagt. Det stærkeste par i huset konfronterer sit første eks-problem. Janelle lærer konsekvenserne af sine handlinger.

programme.title: Ex On The Beach US: How to Keep a Man 101
programme.desc: Chad og Nicoles situation forværres da endnu en eks ankommer. En fest i huset får endnu en deltager til at bryde sammen i jalousi.

programme.desc: I dette afsnit pimper teamet Kerrys Ford Escort. Bilen består af to halvdele af to forskellige Ford Escorts, der er blevet svejset og "klistret" sammen. Teamet mener, den er for farlig at køre rundt i...

programme.title: Pimp My Ride: 1984 Cadillac Eldorado
programme.desc: Xzibit takes a beat-up 1984 Cadillac Eldorado and restores it to it's former glory.

programme.title: Pimp My Ride: 1991 Ford Escort
programme.desc: In this episode, Xzibit and the boys at West Coast Customs transform a '91 Ford Escort into a European luxury mobile.

programme.title: Pimp My Ride: 1958 VW Bus
programme.desc: In this episode, Xzibit and West Coast Customs give a 1958 VW some California love, and turn it into the ultimate beach ride.

programme.title: Pimp My Ride: 1985 Suburban
programme.desc: In this episode, Xzibit takes a busted off-road '85 Suburban and gives it an electronic makeover not to be believed.

programme.title: Pimp My Ride: 1987 Chevrolet Blazer
programme.desc: In this episode, Xzibit puts the fire back into a wrecked '87 Chevy Blazer.

programme.title: Pimp My Ride: 1988 Acura Legend
programme.desc: In this episode, Xzibit and West Coast Customs help a 1988 Acura Legend live up to its name.

programme.title: Pimp My Ride: 2005 Toyota 4Runner
programme.desc: When Xzibit rolls on into the garage with the Fairlane, the boys can't believe their eyes. So they decide to give West his Fairlane back to tinker with and get him a brand-new pimped Toyota 4Runner.

programme.title: Are You The One?: You Can't Handle the Truth
programme.desc: Ti singlepiger og ti singlefyre skal tilbringe en måned sammen mens de finder ud af, hvem som passer sammen. Klarer de det, kan de dele det største præmiebeløb i MTV\s historie - en million dollar.

programme.title: Are You The One?: The Temptation of Chris T
programme.desc: Chris T satser hele prisen på en million dollar eftersom han ikke kan give slip på Shanley, og da Ryans dagbøger forsvinder søger han trøst hos Kayla - der selv søger trøst hos Wes.

programme.title: Are You The One?: A Real 'G'
programme.desc: Situationen er spændt mellem Jacy og Simone, der kæmper om Johns gunst. Og det hotter op mellem Brittany og Adam, der tager en tur i boom-boom-rummet , og i udfordringen afslører pigerne pinlige ting om sig selv.

programme.title: Are You The One?: Karma's a Bitch
programme.desc: I udfordringen afslører fyrenes ekser ting og sager og overnatter i huset. Brittany har svært ved at acceptere, at Adam ikke er interesseret. Og Coleysia og Ashleigh tænder op under romantikken.

programme.title: Are You The One?: Double Shot
programme.desc: Situationen er spændt mellem John og Simone. Kayla bliver interesseret i Wes igen, men hun holder stasig fast i Ryan. Humøret stiger, da de kan sende to par i sandhedsboksen efter udfordringen.

programme.title: Are You The One?: Turn The Paige
programme.desc: Alle præver at regne ud, hvem der er det perfekte par. Kayla bliver afsløret, da hun spiller Ryan ud mod Wes, og Simone prøver at splitte Chris T og Shanley. Et besøg i sandhedsboksen vender op og ned på alt i huset.

programme.title: Are You The One?: It's So Hard...To Say Goodbye
programme.desc: Huset er rystet, da Paige og Chris T bliver bekræftet som det perfekte par og sendes til Bryllupssuiten. Shanley er totalt knust efter at være blevet skilt fra Chris T, og Kayla flipper ud, da Ryan vil trøste Jessica.

programme.title: Are You The One?: Getting Dumped On
programme.desc: Kayla og Ryan skændes, men huset vender sig mod Kayla, da hun afslører følsomme oplysninger, der truer Ambers forhold til Ethan. En slibrig udfordring tester nogle af parrenes evne til at holde sammen.

programme.title: Are You The One?: White Party
programme.desc: Til hvid fest har alle i huset det sjovt, men John må forholde sig til Jacys følelser for Scali. I en udfordring på stranden får parrene sand under neglene.

programme.title: Are You The One?: Rub Down With A Happy Ending
programme.desc: Huset forsøger at regne ud, hvordan de finder deres perfekte match og vinder en million dollars. Jacy ser sine følelser for Scali og John i øjnene, da huset forsøger at løse den sidste kærlighedstrekant.
programme.sub-title: Rub Down With A Happy Ending

programme.title: Are You The One?: Reunion Special
programme.desc: Alle de tyve deltagere bliver genforenet med Ryan Devlin for at diskutere, hvad der skete på Hawaii, og vi viser ikke tidligere vist materiale, chokerende afsløringer og sladder om parrene som fortsat er sammen.

programme.title: Are You The One?: Are You The One? Special Delivery
programme.desc: Deltagerne i første sæson genforenes til den største begivenhed i Ethans og Ambers liv - en baby! Find ud af, hvordan det er gået med deltagerne, mens de tilbringer en vild weekend sammen for at fejre babyen med et AYTO-gave.
programme.sub-title: Are You The One? Special Delivery

programme.title: Are You The One?: One Too Many
programme.desc: 10 perfekt sammensatte fyre og piger får et chok, når de finder ud af, det bliver sværere at finde 10 par, for der er 11 piger. Paris og Pratt prøver at undgå den første sandhedsbås.

programme.title: Are You The One?: The Truth Will Cost You
programme.desc: Teamet bliver spændt, da både Layton og Shelby havner i kærlighedstrekanter. Fyrene graver ting op om pigerne i en konkurrence, som kan sende den ellevte pige i sandhedsbåsen.

programme.title: Are You The One?: Virgin Tears
programme.desc: Der er tårer, da Shelby afslutter sin kærlighedstrekant. John prøver at nærme sig Christina, men bliver blokeret af Brandon, hendes ikke-match. Teamet bliver chokeret da de hører, at der er en jomfru blandt dem.

programme.title: Are You The One?: Loose Lips Sink Relationships
programme.desc: En fuld kikser kan splitte det stærkeste par i huset. Anthony bager heftigt på Laytons forelskelse, Jenni. John prøver endelig lykken med Christina. Parceremonien gør huset helt rundt på gulvet.

programme.title: Are You The One?: Strap Those Boots Tight
programme.desc: Huset er chokeret efter sidste parceremoni. Jenni mener, at Layton er hendes rette fyr, men frygter at en knust Jessica bliver vred. For et par truer sandhedsbåsen med at bringe mere hjertesorg.

programme.title: Are You The One?: Parental Guidance
programme.desc: Pigerne får overraskende informationer, når deres forældre kommer for at udspørge fyrene. Når forældrene rejser, eksploderer spændingerne mellem Layton og Anthony. Huset finder ud af, at historien kan gentage sig.

programme.title: Are You The One?: Hot Salsa
programme.desc: Efter en mislykket parceremoni er huset klar til en ny start. John mener endelig at have fundet den rette i Jenni, men de andre i huset er ikke så sikre. Ashley befinder sig i et potentielt eksplosivt trekantsdrama.

programme.title: Are You The One?: Dumped
programme.desc: Kampen mellem Dario og Layton over Ashley strammer til. Ellie vender sin opmærksomhed mod Nathan, som er overbevist om, at Christina er hans perfekte partner. For Christina bliver presset med at være pige nummer 11 for meget.

programme.title: Are You The One?: Old Flames
programme.desc: Selvom de ikke er et par, eksploderer Nathan, når Christina går tilbage til Brandon. Med to parceremonier tilbage, kunne Ashleys ubeslutsomhed mellem Layton og Dario afholde huset fra at vinde det hele.

programme.title: Are You The One?: One Switch, One Glitch
programme.desc: Det er den sidste parceremoni og de skal udskifte et par. Mens sandhedsbåsen giver et tiltrængt svar, bringer spørgsmålet om pige nummer 11 millionen i fare.

programme.title: Awkward: The Big Reveal
programme.desc: Jenna vil afsløre sandheden for Matty, men vil hendes nærmeste stoppe hende?

programme.title: Awkward: An Indecent Promposal
programme.desc: Eleverne inviterer hinanden til bal, og Jenna får nogle overraskende nyheder.

programme.title: Awkward: Say No To The Dress
programme.desc: Jenna har bestemt sig for at få det perfekte bal, men der er mange forhindringer i vejen.

programme.title: Awkward: Reality Does Not Bite
programme.desc: Skoleballet byder på mange overraskelser.

programme.title: Awkward: The Graduates
programme.desc: Eksamensfesten kan blive ødelagt, da Sadie fået et forbud mod at gå hente sit bevis.

programme.title: Awkward: Holding on and Letting Go
programme.desc: Alle prøver at få den sidste aften på skolen til at blive noget særligt.

programme.title: Awkward: I'm the Kind of Girl Who Found Her Voice in College
programme.desc: Jenna er på toppen af verden, da hun kommer hjem fra sit første år på college, men hendes nye selvtillid rystes, da hun opdager, at hun ikke er den eneste, som har forandret sig.
programme.sub-title: I'm the Kind of Girl Who Found Her Voice in College

programme.title: Awkward: WTF Happened Last Year?
programme.desc: Jenna afslører, hvad der skete med hende og resten af slænget i året der gik - hvad der var grunden til det kølige forhold mellem Matty og Jenna, hvad der startede venskabet mellem Sadie og Tamara og hvordan Jake og Lissa fandt romantikken.

programme.title: Awkward: The Friend Connection
programme.desc: Jenna undgår et nyt forhold for at få kontakt med dem, hun arbejder sammen med. Imens holder Tamara en chik fødselsdagsfest for Sadie - som efterlader mere end en festdeltager i dårligt festhumør.

programme.title: Awkward: Best Friends For Never
programme.desc: I et forsøg på at gøre Idea Bin til et hyggeligere sted for hende selv, skaffer Jenna en praktikplads til Tamara, men opdager hurtigt, det kan være katastrofalt at arbejde med venner.

programme.title: Awkward: Fireworks
programme.desc: Jake giver Jenna og Tamara vagter i country-klubben den 4. juli, men Sullys planer om en efterfest på golfbanen resulterer i et dramatisk fyrværkeri.

programme.title: Awkward: Digging Deep
programme.desc: Efter en sjov 4. juli, fortsætter Jenna og Matty med at fyre op under venskabet ved at holde fest for Jake - i det mindste indtil Jennas nyeste Idea Bin-post truer med at afsløre alt.

programme.title: Awkward: Girls Gone Viral
programme.desc: Jenna prøver at vælge mellem succes hos Idea Bin og sit venskab med Matty. Jake oplever et uventet intimt møde, og Sadie og Sergio afslører pludselig mere end nogensinde før.

programme.title: Awkward: Misadventures in Babysitting
programme.desc: Jenna melder sig som barnepige og modtager uventet hjælp af Matty. Imens får Lissa at vide, hvad der er hemmeligheden ved at være en Palos Hills-mor, og Tamara og Sadie får mere end nok til en rig teenagers strandfest.

programme.title: Awkward: Living in Sin
programme.desc: Jenna tager forholdet med Luke et nyt niveau og Tamaras gæld kommer tilbage og bider hende i halen.

programme.title: Awkward: Home Again, Home Again
programme.desc: Et skænderi med Luke presser Jenna til at tage med til lejrgenforeningen og dermed mod at genoptage kontakten med Matty.

programme.title: Awkward: Second Chances
programme.desc: Luke hjælper Jenna med at få et vigtigt møde på SCU, Tamara er ærlig over for Patrick om sine pengeproblemer, og Matty får Sadies hjælp til at komme ind i varmen igen hos Lacey.

programme.title: Awkward: Happy Campers, Happier Trails
programme.desc: Jenna må vælge mellem et vigtigt SCU-event og lejrgenforeningen, noget der fører til et endnu større valg: Luke eller Matty. Men hun er ikke alene, for både Jake, Tamara og Lissa må også tage afgørende valg.

programme.title: Awkward: Pilot
programme.desc: Det går fra slemt til rigtig slemt for Jenna Hamilton, når et mystisk brev får alle til at tro, at hun har forsøgt at begå selvmord. Jenna foretager nogle store ændringer i sit liv snarere end at lade sin nye identitet definere hende.

programme.title: Awkward: Knocker Nightmare
programme.desc: Sadie og Lissa sms'er et nøgenfoto af Jenna i pigernes omklædningsrum til hele skolen. Ud over latterliggørelse og sladder får spøgen nogle overraskende reaktioner fra Jennas store forelskelse Matty.

programme.title: Awkward: The Way We Weren't
programme.desc: Jenna undrer sig over, om Matt vil stå frem med deres forhold, da han inviterer hende til en fest. Jenna indser også, at hun måske har mere til fælles med Jake.

programme.title: Awkward: The Scarlet Eye
programme.desc: Jenna vil definere sit forhold til Matty, men er bekymret for, at hun risikerer at miste ham. Imens nyder Tamara sin første sexskandale efter hun fik øjenbetændelse i en heftig omgang i et boblebad.

programme.title: Awkward: Jenna Lives
programme.desc: En mærkelig stalker puster liv i Jennas selvmordshistorie. Jenna undrer sig over, om hendes omdømme afholder Matty fra at se hende som kærestemateriale.

programme.title: Awkward: Queen Bee-atches
programme.desc: Jenna omgås de lede piger, da hun hjælper med Palos Verdes' elite mor/datter velgørende organisation. Det bliver mere akavet, da hun støder ind i Matty og Jake.

programme.title: Awkward: Over My Dead Body
programme.desc: Jenna får rollen som offer i en event om spirituskørsel. Hun kæmper med rollen, mens Jake og Matty kæmper om hendes opmærksomhed.

programme.title: Awkward: The Adventures of Aunt Ally and the Lil' Bitch
programme.desc: Da Laceys BFF Ally kommer til byen beslutter de at 'hjælpe' Jenna med at drikke sig stiv. Næste dag har en glemsom Jenna tømmermænd og kæmper med at huske den vilde aften og hvem hun kyssede.
programme.sub-title: The Adventures of Aunt Ally and the Lil' Bitch

programme.title: Awkward: My Super Bittersweet Sixteen
programme.desc: Jenna får en pinlig 16-års fødselsdag og må håndtere følgerne af alle dem, hun har skubbet væk. Efter hun dumper køreprøven, undrer hun sig over, om hun kan reparere forholdet til Matty og Tamara.

programme.title: Awkward: No Doubt
programme.desc: Matty inviterer Jenna ud på deres første rigtige date. Men en afsløring får Jenna til at tvivle på alt ved sin romance med Matty.

programme.title: Awkward: I Am Jenna Hamilton
programme.desc: Romantik er i luften, og alle er begejstrede for Winter Formal. Selvom Jenna længes efter den store spørger, forsøger hun ikke at lade Matty's afslappede holdning skuffe hende.

programme.title: Awkward: Fateful
programme.desc: Jenna må endelig bestemme sig mellem Jake og Matty. Tamaras kærlighedsliv tager en overraskende drejning. Ming bringer en uventet date, og mysteriet bag pleje-frontation-brevet afsløres.

programme.title: Awkward: Resolutions
programme.desc: Jenna undgår at beskæftige sig med afsløringen af, at hendes mor skrev konfrontationsbrevet. I stedet spreder hun julehumør og nytårsstemning, indtil Jakes gave tvinger hende til at beslutte, om hun er klar til at glemme Matty helt.

programme.title: Awkward: Sex, Lies and the Sanctuary
programme.desc: Jenna nyder, at forholdet med Jake endelig er blevet officielt, indtil hun hører om de seneste måneders skjulte kameraoptagelser fra Sanctuary. Hun går derefter ekstremt til værks - og hverver bl.a. Ming - for ødelægge båndet.

programme.title: Awkward: Three's a Crowd
programme.desc: Jenna prøver at slutte fred med Matty og behage Jake, men har svært ved at ignorere Mattys evindelige flirten og klæbrige opførsel. Hans handlinger får hende til at stille spørgsmålstegn ved, hvem der egentligt er problemet i trioen.

programme.title: Awkward: Are You There God? It's Me, Jenna
programme.desc: Jenna er stadig ikke kommet sig over sine forældres separation og føler sig ansvarlig. I et impulsivt forsøg på at tilgive sig selv søger hun tilflugt fra sine problemer hos de højere magter i den religiøse lejrskole.
programme.sub-title: Are You There God? It's Me, Jenna

programme.title: Awkward: My Love is a Black Heart
programme.desc: Jenna forbereder sig på sin første Valentinsdag med en kæreste, men både hun og Tamara bliver jaloux, da det går op for dem, at deres ekskærester måske er ved at være klar til at komme videre med deres liv og glemme dem.
programme.sub-title: My Love is a Black Heart

programme.title: Awkward: What Comes First: Sex or Love?
programme.desc: Jenna har stadig ikke genfundet sit fodfæste efter Jakes kærlighedserklæring, og hun overvejer, om det at have sex med ham vil give hende klarhed om sine egne følelser.
programme.sub-title: What Comes First: Sex or Love?

programme.title: Awkward: Another one Bites the Dust
programme.desc: Jenna er klar til at have sex med Jake efter endelig at have fået klarhed over sine følelser. Hendes beslutsomhed bliver imidlertid grundigt testet af tante Allys bryllup, en mand fra hendes mors fortid og en intrigant Sadie.

programme.title: Awkward: Time After Time
programme.desc: Dårlig timing og afsløringer efterlader både Jenna og Jake knuste.

programme.title: Awkward: Homewrecker Hamilton
programme.desc: Jenna har svært ved at rede trådene ud i sit forskruede kærlighedsliv efter brud og genforeninger med drengene - lige indtil en uventet tekst placerer hendes dramatiske liv lige midt i rampelyset.

programme.title: Awkward: Pick Me, Choose Me, Love Me
programme.desc: Efter Jennas udgivelse af sin blog har alle pludselig en mening om hendes liv. Mens alle andre følger med for underholdningens skyld, kræver Jake og Matty svar.
programme.sub-title: Pick Me, Choose Me, Love Me

programme.title: Awkward: Once Upon a Blog
programme.desc: Jennas fantasi løber af med hende, og hun omdanner sin blog til en fiktiv fortælling i et forsøg på at ændre sin skæbne. Ved at undersøge og forestille sig en anden udgave af sin fortid forsøger Jenna at gennemskue fremtiden.

programme.title: Shriek If You Know What I Did Last Friday The 13th
programme.desc: En journalist (Tiffani-Amber Thiessen) efterforsker en række mord kaldet Spring Break-massakren, som fører til yderligere kaos i denne parodi på slasherfilm.

programme.title: Fisherman's Friends
programme.desc: FISHERMAN'S FRIENDS er baseret på den sande og utrolige historie om ti erfarne fiskere, som gik fra at optræde på den lokale pub i Port Isaac til udsolgte stadionkoncerter. Det er en hjertevarm, humoristisk og ikke mindst musikalsk film.

programme.title: Peace, Love & Misunderstanding
programme.desc: Diane er en snerpet advokat fra New York, der netop er blevet vraget af sin mand. I et desperat forsøg på at glemme alt om skilsmissen, tager hun sammen med sine to teenagebørn på en impulsiv weekendtur. Destinationen er en økologisk gård nær Woodstock.

programme.title: My Neighbor Adolf
programme.desc: Sydamerika, 1960. Den ensomme og gnavne Holocaust-overlever Polsky er overbevist om, at hans nye nabo er selveste Adolf Hitler. Da han ikke bliver taget alvorligt, indleder han sin egen undersøgelse for at bevise sin påstand.

programme.title: Down To You
programme.desc: Fra det øjeblik de mødes i universitetets kaos i New York City, begynder Al (Freddie Prinze Jr.) og Imogen (Julia Stiles) deres romantiske rejse, hvor ægte kærlighed ofte konkurrer med fristelsen til at vige fra engagementet.

programme.title: Brad's Status
programme.desc: Brad har en udmærket karriere og lever et komfortabelt liv sammen med sin hustru og søn, men hans gamle venners liv virker mere glamourøst og rigt. Da han genoptager kontakten med dem, kommer han dog til at tvivle på, hvem der lever det gode liv.

programme.title: Mean Girls
programme.desc: Efter Cady har boet i Afrika, aner hun intet om, hvor 'vilde' ting kan blive i civilisationen, indtil hun møder den ondeste art 'Queen Bee', der på denne skole er den kølige og kalkulerende Regina George.

programme.title: Youth In Revolt
programme.desc: På en ferie møder den kiksede teenager Nick Twisp drømmepigen Sheeni. Nick, der ikke tidligere har haft held med piger, vil gøre alt for at vinde hendes hjerte og opfinder et alter-ego, den flamboyante og dristige Francois Dillinger.

programme.title: Orange County
programme.desc: Shaun er tilfreds med at være en kvik, men doven surfer, indtil han en dag læser en roman af den anerkendte forfatter Martin Skinner. Han forlader Orange County for at læse på Standford University og lære at skrive.

programme.title: Like Crazy
programme.desc: En college-studerende fra England forelsker sig i en amerikansk studerende, men de skilles ad, da hun må forlade USA, fordi hendes visum er udløbet.

programme.title: Birdman
programme.desc: For at bevise sit værd risikerer en tidligere filmhelt alt. I sin kamp mod forskelige kritikere, et alter ego, sin datter og en skuespiller stræber han efter at komme ud af middelmådigheden.

programme.title: Black Book
programme.desc: Den unge jøde Rachel overlever med nød og næppe nazisternes invasion af Holland, men må så opleve, at hele hendes familie bliver myrdet. Fast besluttet på at få hævn går hun med i modstandsbevægelsen for at infiltrere det tyske hovedkvarter i Holland.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Millionaire Murder
programme.desc: A businessman went to Florida to make one last deal before he retired-he never returned home to his millions. Authorities examined who was closest to him and who stood to gain from his disappearance. But this time conventional rules didn't apply.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Deadly Business
programme.desc: Many escape the poverty of India to start new lives in the United States. One turned the American dream into a nightmare. People started turning up dead in New York's Indian community-authorities struggled to link fraud and murder to a powerful man.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Temple of Fear
programme.desc: In Miami, the discovery of a mutilated body sent investigators on the trail of a deadly cult. But agents found a wall of silence around the cult's members. Potential witnesses, terrified of reprisals, refused to talk.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Silent Strike
programme.desc: Money may not be the root of all evil, but for some men, a million dollars is enough to justify murder. Even men sworn to uphold the law can sometimes be tempted.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Deadly Stranger
programme.desc: The body of a young woman found burned in a truck launched a manhunt to find her killer. When more bodies began to turn up across the country, the FBI believed the cases were linked. Investigators had a suspect. They just couldn't find him.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Under Fire
programme.desc: A series of armored car heists and bloody shoot-outs shocked law enforcement. The brutal violence of the crimes suggested a motive more complex than greed. When the robbers started targeting police, the FBI took charge.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Manhunt
programme.desc: A killer was on the loose in one of America's most popular tourist destinations. Armed and desperate, he evaded law enforcement at every turn. As the Fourth of July weekend quickly approached, thousands of people became potential targets.

programme.title: The FBI Files: No Remorse
programme.desc: A burning body in a dark alley shed light on a cold-blooded killer. His partners in crime would tell the story, if they lived. In the underworld of the drug trade, even a childhood friend can quickly become an enemy.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Lost Boys
programme.desc: In June of 1997, a crime wave swept Iowa like a tornado. It left a trail of robbery, kidnapping, and murder in its wake, and then it moved on. No one knew where.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Deadly Threat
programme.desc: A suspected drug dealer would stop at nothing to keep local and federal authorities from building a case against him. When his organization started targeting the government itself, federal agencies went on high alert.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Evil Intent
programme.desc: Drops of blood and a torn screen were all that's left to tell authorities what happened to a woman in Indiana. The 21 yr. old victim was taken from her home on a spring morning. She appeared to have no real enemies, there was no clear motive.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The Coffee Shop Murders
programme.desc: At a coffee shop in Washington, DC, three employees were shot to death. Evidence at the crime scene pointed in many different directions. Was this a hate crime, a robbery gone wrong or an act of cold-blooded vengeance?

programme.title: The FBI Files: The Perfect Heist
programme.desc: Bank robbery is a brazen yet simple crime. A mask, a gun, a note passed to a teller. But bank burglary is different. It takes skill to disable an alarm, to penetrate a locked vault.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Brotherhood of Hate
programme.desc: In 1984, a tragic murder led agents into the frightening world of domestic terrorism. Law enforcement vowed to dismantle the violent faction that claimed responsibility.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: They were a gang of criminal masterminds. They carried automatic weapons and were not afraid to use them. With each and every new heist, they became bolder and more deadly, until the FBI stepped in, determined to end their violent rampage.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Unlawful Flight
programme.desc: In Alabama, two desperate criminals fled the custody of a local deputy. Eluding authorities, they made their way across the country in a wave of car theft, abduction, and murder.

programme.title: The Sentinel
programme.desc: Secret Service agenten Pete Garrison kommer påsporet af en forræder i Det hvide Hus, men bliver selvmistænkt og må bevise sin uskyld - inden det er forsent.

programme.title: Who Gets The Dog
programme.desc: Da Olive og Clay mødte hinanden, var det kærlighed ved første blik. De blev gift, købte hus sammen og adopterede en hvalp – Wesley. Nu er det seks år senere, og de har besluttet at gå fra hinanden, men de vil begge beholde deres elskede Wesley.

programme.title: Peace, Love & Misunderstanding
programme.desc: Diane er en snerpet advokat fra New York, der netop er blevet vraget af sin mand. I et desperat forsøg på at glemme alt om skilsmissen, tager hun sammen med sine to teenagebørn på en impulsiv weekendtur. Destinationen er en økologisk gård nær Woodstock.

programme.title: Humor Me
programme.desc: Humor Me er en hjertevarm komedie om en kriseramt skuespilforfatter, som er tvunget til at flytte ind hos sin vittige far i et pensionistsamfund i New Jersey og lærer, som hans far ofte siger, at ”livet finder sted, om man smiler eller ej”.

programme.title: Can You Keep a Secret?
programme.desc: I den tro at de er ved at styrte ned, fortæller Emma alle sine hemmeligheder til en flot, men vildfremmed mand om bord på et fly. Det vil sige, hun troede, at han var fremmed… Filmen er baseret på bestsellerromanen af samme navn fra Sophie Kinsella.

programme.title: Scary Movie 2
programme.desc: Nogen er gået for vidt med din kærlighed til efterfølgere! Favoritfigurerne fra SCARY MOVIE er tilbage i en film, der skræmmer til mere uærbødig morskab end originalen med sin version af kliche-spøgelsesfilm.

programme.title: Couples Vacation
programme.desc: Mens hans ægteskab og karriere hænger i en tynd tråd, tager den arbejdsløse forfatter Jack Spencer sammen med sin kone Amanda til et afsides 'glamping'-sted for at finde gnisten igen. Men en overraskende dobbeltbooking...

programme.title: Tully
programme.desc: 'Tully' er skrevet og instrueret af skaberne af den højtelskede Oscar-vinder 'Juno'. Skrevet af Diablo Cody (Young Adult) og instrueret af Jason Reitman (Thank You for Smoking, Up in the Air og Young Adult).

programme.title: Black Knight
programme.desc: Da en klog sort hustler fra South Central i Los Angeles bliver transporteret tilbage til middelalderens England, leder han omstyrtelsen af en ond konge og vinder en protofeministisk kvindes hjerte.

programme.title: Med Røven I Vandskorpen
programme.desc: Bill Murray spiller hovedrollen som Tripper Harrison, lejrchefen på Camp North Star. Der er masser af sjov og ballade i vente, mens han sammen med lejrens øvrige ledere gør, hvad han kan for at bryde alle regler.

programme.title: Disaster Movie
programme.desc: Will erfarer, at hans kæreste Amy har en affære med undertøjsmodellen Flavor. Da Will efterfølgende holder en fest kommer Amy med sin nye flamme. Pludselig begynder alt at ryste. Det viser sig, at jorden på samme tid rammes af alle naturkatastrofer.

programme.title: 48 Hours: Mystery on Twin Peaks Drive
programme.desc: A report on the December 16, 1998 death of Ronda Reynolds, whose husband found her lifeless body with a gunshot wound to the head in her home on Twin Peaks Drive in Toledo, Washington.

programme.title: 48 Hours: Stalked: Out of the Shadows
programme.desc: Some stalkers become obsessed with people they do not know. Includes the story of serial stalker Justin Massler who was arrested for stalking Ivanka Trump, and previously targeted the Kardashian family.

programme.title: Fraud Squad: Fraud Squad.S01E13.Car Insurance Fraud & Real Estate Fraud
programme.desc: In an ultimate act of breach of trust, a college professor defrauds the families of eight of his own students.
programme.sub-title: Fraud Squad.S01E13.Car Insurance Fraud & Real Estate Fraud

programme.title: 48 Hours: The One Who Got Away
programme.desc: A report about how serial killer Andrew Urdiales was identified, arrested and convicted, and about the young woman who became the only one of his victims to survive.

programme.title: Dr. G: Medical Examiner
programme.desc: Dr. G. has just graduated from medical school and is set to begin her first job as an M.E. in Jacksonville, Florida when a high-profile case challenges her to use her newly acquired skills.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Cereal Killer
programme.desc: When a fire destroyed most of a home and a young boy went missing, police organized the largest search in the history of their small town. First the boy's backpack was discovered five miles from home, then his body was found 50 miles away.

programme.title: Dr. G: Medical Examiner
programme.desc: Jerra Kirby, who’s visiting family in Orlando, has suddenly passed out at a theme park wave pool and the paramedics are trying desperately to revive her.

programme.title: COPS: Pants Party
programme.desc: A car eludes a DUI checkpoint only to crash, one woman takes the fall for everyone in her group, and a man hides his stash in the one place he thinks police will never look.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Stolen Identity
programme.desc: When a theft is committed, something valuable is stolen. But when a criminal needs a new identity, theft becomes a matter of life and death.

programme.title: On the Case: Deadly Offer
programme.desc: After coming to the aid of a stranded roommate, Stephanie Brown's car is found abandoned on the interstate and her body is later discovered floating in an irrigation ditch, the victim of sexual assault and murder.

programme.title: 48 Hours: Murder on Red River
programme.desc: An investigation into the 2002 murder of Jennifer Harris and the search for clues to what happened to her by a former Marine and a filmmaker who believe they can find the person responsible for the murder.

programme.title: Dr. G: Medical Examiner
programme.desc: On a Texas highway, a fire is discovered having burnt three bodies beyond recognition. Dr. G finds bullets in the bodies and determines that they were all shot before being set on fire.

programme.title: On the Case: Innocent Witness
programme.desc: When Rhonda Boggs is discovered murdered in her own kitchen, police get an important lead from the only witness to the crime, Rhonda's two year old daughter.

programme.title: Dr. G: Medical Examiner
programme.desc: A florist meets with clients for an upcoming wedding, but she suddenly collapses to the floor. With no apparent cause of death, Dr. G worries that this case may go unsolved.

programme.title: 72 Hours: Pointing to Murder
programme.desc: A withered corpse is found half-buried in a field beside a theme park. Too decayed to identify properly, detectives have only the leathery fingers of one hand to work from.

programme.title: COPS: Crash Landing
programme.desc: Police have a breakthrough in a burglary case, a man found with drugs in his pants claims the pants are not his, and officers deal with a familiar domestic disturbance call.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Jean Pool
programme.desc: In 1984, the body of college student Laura Salmon was found on a Middle Tennessee farm, covered with her own denim jeans as well as the jeans of the killer.

programme.title: 48 Hours: Murder in L.A.
programme.desc: Focuses on two California couples: the Adairs and the Shapiros. Mindy Shapiro discovered that her husband Michael, an orthopedic surgeon, was having an affair with Jeanie Adair, and in 1996, after 11 years of marriage, the couple opted for divorce.

programme.title: 48 Hours: Temptation in Texas
programme.desc: A report about the 2011 shooting death of Greg Williams, and the question of whether he was killed with his own gun by an intruder inside his suburban Dallas home - as his wife Michele Williams has claimed - or if Michele herself was guilty of the crime.

programme.title: COPS: Drunk in Love
programme.desc: A driver takes his unsuspecting passenger on a wild ride as he tries to evade police, a man's date is cut short by a traffic stop, and police are called to evict a roommate.

programme.title: City Confidential
programme.desc: A scenic river town becomes the setting for a confrontation between the federal government and Rob Nuckols, owner of a militia-style compound on federal land.

programme.title: Dr. G: Medical Examiner
programme.desc: It is 3 AM and Deputy Torres is cruising a Texas highway when he suddenly spots a crushed pick-up truck along the side of the road. Trapped inside is the lifeless body of 24-year-old Luis Reyes.

programme.title: Dr. G: Medical Examiner
programme.desc: Jeffrey Ortiz, a mentally challenged man with the mental capacity of a nine-year-old, is making himself a sandwich when he inexplicably falls, striking his head on the kitchen counter.

programme.title: South Park: Byens kerne
programme.desc: South Parks bykerne skal opgraderes og Kenny bestemmer sig for, at det er på tide at finde et job.

programme.title: South Park: Mr. Hankeys juleklassikere
programme.desc: Denne special-episode giver nogle numre fra Mr. Hankeys julealbum.

programme.title: South Park: Tam underligheden
programme.desc: Ike kommer i puberteten, og han og Kyle glider fra hinanden. For at blive venner igen tager Kyle Ike med for at se 'Yo Gabba Gabba' live.

programme.title: South Park: Band i Kina
programme.desc: Randy ser en mulighed for Tegridy i Kina.

programme.title: South Park: Crack-baby-atletik
programme.desc: Da Kyle opdager, at Cartman hjælper crack-babyer på det lokale hospital, bliver han mistænksom. Hvilken rolle spiller Slash (fra Guns 'n Roses)?

programme.title: South Park: Størrelsen
programme.desc: Kyles fætter, Kyle Schwartz fra Connecticut, kommer til South Park for at bo der på grund af hans mors dårlige helbred. Kyle er først begejstret, men det varer ikke længe, før 'Kyle 2' begynder at irritere ham.

programme.title: South Park: Jødens lidenskab
programme.desc: Efter at have set 'The Passion of the Christ' plager den fanatiske Cartman Kyle, mens en vanvittig Mel Gibson jagter Stan og Kenny tilbage byen, efter at de har forlangt at få deres penge tilbage.

programme.title: South Park: Verdenskrig Zimmerman
programme.desc: Cartman anser Token for at være en trussel mod hele menneskeheden.

programme.title: South Park: The Jeffersons
programme.desc: En ny familie ankommer til South Park, med en lille dreng ved navn Blanket, en forlystelsespark i haven og en far, der har en svaghed for at synge og for kosmetisk plastikkirurgi. Gæt hvem?

programme.title: South Park: Frizone
programme.desc: Cartman bliver offer for body-shaming.

programme.title: South Park: Chef-hjælp
programme.desc: Chef prøver at opkræve afgifter fra et pladeselskab, da de lancerer en sang, han hævder, at han skrev for over 20 år siden.

programme.title: South Park: Byen på kanten af for evigt (tilbageblik)
programme.desc: Skolebussen ender på kanten af en kløft efter at have forulykket i en snestorm.
programme.sub-title: Byen på kanten af for evigt (tilbageblik)

programme.title: South Park: Cartmanland
programme.desc: Cartman arver en million dollar efter sin bedstemor og opfylder sin livsdrøm om at eje sin egen forlystelsespark, Cartmanland!

programme.title: South Park: Hvalludere
programme.desc: Kyle støder til en gruppe, der laver en dokumentar, som konfronterer japanske hvalfangere, men deres taktik er langt fra imponerende.

programme.title: South Park: Røvburgere
programme.desc: Stan's eksistentielle krise fortsætter, og Cartman går ind i burgerbranchen med en superhemmelig, helt særlig ingrediens.

programme.title: South Park: South Park
programme.desc: Stan er forfærdet, da han indser, at han har misforstået nogle af historiens største bøger.

programme.title: South Park: Frem med dillerne
programme.desc: Drengene slår sig sammen for at kæmpe for deres rettigheder.

programme.title: South Park: South ParQ Vaccination Special
programme.desc: Borgerne i South Park vil vaccineres mod corona. En hylemorsom ny militant gruppe forsøger at stoppe drengene fra at få deres lærer vaccineret.

programme.title: South Park: Osama Bin Ladens prutbukser
programme.desc: Efter at være blevet sendt til Afghanistan ved et uheld, kæmper drengene mod Osama og Taliban. De lærer, at de har mere til fælles med de afghanske børn, end de nogensinde havde forestillet sig.

programme.title: South Park: Mysteriet om de to urinaler
programme.desc: Cartman tror, han ved, hvem der stod bag angrebene den 9/11.

programme.title: South Park: Cartmans mor er en beskidt sæk
programme.desc: Dr. Mephisto hjælper Cartman umed at afsløre sandheden om hans fars identitet. Det bringer alle South Parks mandlige indbyggere i søgelyset.
programme.sub-title: Cartmans mor er en beskidt sæk

programme.title: South Park: Døde børn
programme.desc: Randy forsøger desperat at hjælpe Sharon med at kontrollere sine følelser, og Cartman dumper i matematik.

programme.title: South Park: Succubus
programme.desc: Cartman er hos optikeren, en mand der gør nar af hans vægtproblem ved at kalde ham 'Piggy'.

programme.title: South Park: Go Gud Go XII!
programme.desc: Cartman nedfryser sig selv og vågner op 500 år ud i fremtiden.

programme.title: South Park: Fattig og dum
programme.desc: Cartmans nye ambition her i livet er at blive en NASCAR-kører. Kan Cartman vinde sit livs racerløb?

programme.title: South Park: Tandfe-tingeltangel 2000
programme.desc: Cartman får 2 dollar af tandfeen, så drengene trækker så mange tænder som muligt ud i håb om at kunne købe et nyt videospillesystem.

programme.title: South Park: Op med Down-steroiden
programme.desc: Der afholdes 'Special Olympics' i South Park, og Cartman må overbevise komiteen om, at han er handicappet, så han kan slå Jimmy i den kommende begivenhed.

programme.title: South Park: Black Friday
programme.desc: Drengene forbereder sig på at slås mod andre kunder på den første dag i julehandlen.

programme.title: South Park: Roger Ebert burde droppe fed mad
programme.desc: Drengene bliver taget med til det lokale planetarium, hvor de bliver hypnotiseret til at arbejde som frivillige.
programme.sub-title: Roger Ebert burde droppe fed mad

programme.title: South Park: Deep Learning
programme.desc: Stan er chokeret, da skolen rystes af en snydeskandal.

programme.title: South Park: Problemet med en bæ
programme.desc: Mr. Hankeys stødende opførsel bringer ham i fare for at blive fyret som direktør for det årlige juleshow. Imens møder Stærk Kvinde og Rektor PK nogle helt nye udfordringer i deres forhold.

programme.title: South Park: Kongelig budding
programme.desc: Da den canadiske prinsesse bliver kidnappet til sit bryllup, bliver Ike sendt til Canada for at hjælpe med at finde hende. Hvilket uhyre har mon begået denne skrækkelige forbrydelse?

programme.title: South Park: Historien om Scrotie McBoogerballs
programme.desc: Butters får skylden - og derefter æren - efter drengene skriver en bog, som skulle være vildt grov, men som bliver hyldet som et mesterværk.

programme.title: South Park: D-Yikes!
programme.desc: Ms. Garrison beslutter, at blive lesbisk, efter at hun igen er blevet svigtet. Drengene hyrer mexikanske immigranter til at lave deres hjemmeopgaver.

programme.title: South Park: Pinewood Derby
programme.desc: Randy og Stan opdager uforvarende warphastighed, så Jorden kan nu blive optaget i Det galaktiske planetforbund, men en rumgangster truer med at ødelægge alting.

programme.title: South Park: Discount kabel-tv
programme.desc: Scott Malkinson er desperat efter at imponere den nye pige i klassen.
